title: Prioritize co-creative spaced practice and preserve partial understanding
summary: The user selects spaced practice and the LLM co-creation loop as the most important current work, with ergonomic APIs discovered through rapid iteration and a maintained exemplar library. Questions should be negotiated around useful insights and misunderstandings; mistake observations and model hypotheses stay distinct; partial understanding and purpose-relative cognitive debt remain legitimate. The assistant proposes a complete local practice loop followed by varied small examples. Implementation, shared API policy and a new run are not approved by this planning request.
